g.text: divider ×0.185 (e0_d): S0 into the pair's range
gate (e0g): a tail of 0 to its full current as T goes 0 to 0.3 V
write (e0_w): by tunnelling into m, a SONOS cell
e0_w: the write's output, held at agnd
(its current measured by a 0 V source)

svg.text: Transistors: SKY130 core (nfet_01v8, pfet_01v8), W/L 4/4 µm; nMOS bodies to vss (−0.9 V), pMOS bodies to vdd (+0.9 V). A memory is a SONOS cell, written by tunnelling.
A dot joins wires; wires crossing without one don't connect. A pointed blue label is a node of the top sheet; a plain label joins within this sheet.
Drawn from the netlist minimal/spice.py writes for SPICE, and checked against it: every connection here is the netlist's, and only those.
